ambiguity: GLOSS.cube ambiguity 2: is a Cube on a grid aligned to the grid, or can it be turned freely, and is a creature in it when any part of its square is or only its centre?
ruling: A Cube is aligned to the grid and extends at right angles away from the face holding its origin. A creature is in it when the centre of its space is inside (as P-23). So a 15-ft Cube holds exactly 3×3 squares, a diagonal aim can't make it take in more, and the squares level with the origin's face (beside a Thunderwave caster) aren't in it.
